terra.problem: The verse says the LORD rebukes the sea and makes the rivers run dry. It does not say He rebukes the rivers or that the land withers because of the water drying up.
Saying everything droops when the sea and rivers run dry adds a timing or causal connection the verse does not give.
The runaway-cookie comparison makes light of the LORD pursuing His enemies and puts the comparison on God's side of the action.
The verse says plots will be brought to an end and affliction will not rise a second time. It does not say that whatever is brought to an end cannot return.
Dry and soaked are not close in sound.
The explanation is flat and generic. It repeats the missing word without bringing the image to life.
The statement that nobody is getting locked up goes beyond the LORD's promise to remove Judah's shackles.
The command says there will be no descendants to carry on Nineveh's name. Saying no one will carry it forward is broader than that.
The verse mentions mountains, not hills. It also places the messenger's feet on the mountains; it does not say the messenger is coming from there.
